clauses.title: CL-D80 records the writer launch's acceptance setting
clauses.section: ## CL-D80 — The exact-autofix writer launch carries no pi-subagents acceptance gate
requires: Packaging the writer launch as a builder, or giving it any other acceptance setting or time bound, requires a new owner decision
`false` is pi-subagents' deprecated shorthand for `{ level: "none" }`
an elapsed deadline is terminal and not a mutation-safe boundary
